codeReview.summary: The architecture.md document (565 lines) fully satisfies all feature requirements. All 9 decisions (a)–(i) have the required Decision/Rationale (≥3 sentences each)/Alternatives Considered (≥1 named rejection) structure. Decision (c) explicitly names all three runtime goroutines (ConsoleStreamPump, ConsoleAskRuntime, ConsoleCancelRuntime) and describes how each collapses into Bounded[Req, Upd]. Decision (d) names ambient ShellState and explains how CockpitState + Reduce() replaces the scattered s.state.Update() closures. Decision (f) explicitly describes what renders during the boot gap (LoadingState spinner with target URL, EmptyState in Detail lane, collapsed Evidence lane). The .gsx Toolchain section provides exact regeneration command, editable glob (*.gsx), forbidden-edit glob (*_gsx.go), add-a-view checklist (6 steps), and generated artifact paths. The Traceability table has exactly 6 rows mapping all audit findings to decisions with path:line citations. The Surface Ownership table mentions all 5 DESIGN.md surfaces (Runtime, Companion, Rooms, Orchestration, Events) across 8 rows with duplication resolutions. The Reconciliation section is 544 words (≥150 requirement), links both go-tui-agent-shell.md and DESIGN.md, and names 5 DESIGN.md principles with concrete decision mappings. The document is well-structured, thorough, and meets all validation contract requirements.

sharedStateObservations.observation: The regeneration command documented as `go generate github.com/grindlemire/go-tui/cmd/tui@v0.11.0 ./internal/interfaces/tui/...` may be imprecise — the `go generate` directive in the .gsx source is what drives regeneration, not a direct `go generate` with a module path. The alternative form `tui generate ./internal/interfaces/tui/...` is likely the correct canonical command. This could confuse future LLM authors who try the first form verbatim. The research doc (research-go-tui.md) has more detail on the actual command.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: architecture.md lines ~389-393 show both forms; the `go generate` with full module path + version is unusual syntax and may not work as written

sharedStateObservations.observation: The generated artifact paths table currently lists only one entry (shell_gsx.go from shell.gsx). While this is accurate for the current codebase, the feature description asked for a 'list of generated artifact paths' — the document handles this by noting 'When new .gsx files are added, the corresponding *_gsx.go file joins this list.' This is acceptable but could be more explicit about what paths are expected for M2/M3.
